def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

def solve(a):
    import copy
    b=[r[:] for r in a]; H=len(b); W=len(b[0])
    ok=True
    for i in range(H):
        r=b[i]; nonzero=[(j,v) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=0]
        if not nonzero: continue
        best=None
        for p in range(1,W+1):
            if all((j%p)==(q%p) or True for j,v in nonzero for q,_ in [(None,None)]) : pass
        # minimal p s.t. all pairs j,j+p have same value
        ps=[p for p in range(1,W+1) if all((r[j]==r[(j+p)%W] or r[(j+p)%W]==0) for j in range(W) if r[j]!=0)]
        if not ps: continue
        p=min(ps)
        for j in range(W):
            k=j%p
            vals={v for jj,v in enumerate(r) if jj%p==k and v!=0}
            if len(vals)>1: ok=False; break
            b[i][j]=vals.pop() if vals else 0
        if not ok: return None
    if not ok: return None
    return b
